name: Haruno Sakura
source: Elder of the Haruno twin sisters. Serious and cautious girl, she sometimes has a tendency to hesitate. While sometimes she finds Kaede to be a bit frustrating, but in the end she still loves her sister very much. Compared to her sister, her body is still developing. Compared to the other girls in the story, she is regarded as the most normal.
